summary_1line: Vidura brings the Pandavas to Hastinapura; Dhritarashtra grants them half the kingdom, and they transform the wilderness of Khandavaprastha into splendid Indraprastha.

image_candidates.scene_text: The Pandavas ride into Hastinapura amid dense crowds of joyful citizens who stretch out their arms and shout blessings.
Dhritarashtra sits in the royal court as the Pandavas bow before Bhishma and the elders, receiving half the kingdom.
From a barren wilderness rises the fortified city of Indraprastha, with high white walls, broad streets, and lush gardens filled with peacocks and lotus ponds.
